versions.changelog:
- Major update: Comprehensive framework and best practices for planning and evaluating free tools as marketing assets.
- Expanded guidance on identifying problems worth solving, tool types, and aligning with business/product strategy.
- Added ideation frameworks, evaluation scorecard, and minimum viable product (MVP) suggestions.
- Included detailed lead capture strategies with pros/cons of gating options.
- Enhanced section on SEO and link building considerations for tool pages.
- Specifies when to build, use no-code, or embed existing tools.
- Clarifies distinction from downloadable lead magnets (refer to "lead-magnets" skill for those).
